text: 那件仪式长袍吸引了你的注意，于是你决定出价。你在纸上签下名字，写出一个合乎情理的价格，再把投标单和其他人的放在一起。你等着沃伦先生宣布长袍由谁得标。

en.title: Alone Against the Tide · 30
text: The ceremonial robe catches your eye, and you settle on placing a bid. You sign your name on a paper with a realistic price and put your submission in with the rest. You wait for Mr. Warren to call out the robe’s winner.
